edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “Garces Perez faces up to 20 years in prison if convicted on the assault charge.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “Garcés Pérez faces up to 20 years in prison if convicted on the assault charge.”.

On 2026-10-02, The Guardian reported “The federal officer who shot Garcés Pérez, and who allegedly was hit by the side mirror of the car, was not wearing a body camera.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “The federal officer who shot Garces Perez, and who allegedly was hit by the side mirror of Garces Perez’s car, wasn’t wearing a body camera.”.

On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “Garces Perez struck an officer with his side mirror on Sept. 20 while trying to drive away, authorities said.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “The authorities said Garcés Pérez struck an officer with his side mirror on 20 September while trying to drive away after a traffic stop and questioning.”.
